2.23.40
Tablix.Visibility
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Tablix.Visibility element specifies the presentational presence of a Tablix. This element is
optional and MUST NOT be specified more than once. If this element is specified, it is of type Visibility.
Following is the parent element of the Tablix.Visibility element.
Parent elements
Tablix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Tablix.Visibility element.
 <xsd:element name="Visibility" type="VisibilityType" minOccurs="0" />
